width_assumption: INT8 materialized core; INT32 constants and post-head decode. Not a quantized model export.

arena.note: Relative private DDR offsets, not assigned physical addresses; no in-place reuse or graph fusion

traffic.note: No retries; per-scalar read ceiling includes padding taps conservatively. No finite wall-time bound without DDR service guarantee.

nms.note: Full unbounded-candidate source semantics; no hidden top-K or two-ROI cap. IoU arithmetic and quantization not implemented.
